title: Dual-Stopband Balanced Stack with Mixed Quarter-Wave Conditions
scientific_hypothesis: A non-periodic stack with layer thicknesses optimized for both 355 nm and 1050 nm quarter-wave conditions simultaneously will achieve acceptable suppression in both stopbands while maintaining reasonable visible transmission.
design_principle: By varying layer thicknesses within the stack (some layers near 355 nm quarter-wave, others near 1050 nm quarter-wave), multiple reflection bands can be created. This sacrifices peak performance in any single band for balanced dual-stopband performance.
proposed_topology: Air | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Ta2O5 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate
design_variables: individual layer thicknesses for all 36 layers, initialized with mixed pattern: odd pairs near 355 nm quarter-wave, even pairs near 1050 nm quarter-wave, tuned during optimization
soft_objectives: balance average transmittance minimization in 355-365 nm and 1030-1080 nm
maintain average transmittance above threshold in 420-700 nm
keep individual layer thicknesses within 20-350 nm
manufacturing_considerations: thickness variation between adjacent layers may increase deposition complexity
thermal stress management critical per L28 with mixed thickness pattern
L01 supports Ta2O5/SiO2 for photonic crystal applications
theory_basis: Multi-band photonic crystal design via thickness modulation
Superposition of multiple Bragg reflection conditions
expected_advantages: More flexible design space than periodic stacks
May reveal optimal trade-off point between competing objectives
known_risks: Neither stopband may achieve deep suppression compared to single-band optimized designs
Passband ripple may be irregular due to non-periodic structure
Optimization landscape may be more complex with multiple local minima
execution_request_english: Design a 36-layer custom dielectric filter on fused silica substrate with air incidence at 0 degrees, unpolarized light. Stack structure: Air | alternating Ta2O5 (Gao) and SiO2 (Gao) layers (36 total layers, 18 of each material) | Fused Silica. Initialize layer thicknesses with mixed pattern: layers 1-18 near 355 nm quarter-wave condition, layers 19-36 near 1050 nm quarter-wave condition. Optimize all 36 individual layer thicknesses within 20-350 nm bounds to balance minimization of average transmittance in 355-365 nm and 1030-1080 nm bands while maintaining high average transmittance in 420-700 nm band. Report final layer thickness sequence and transmittance spectra across 350-1100 nm.
